issues.description: The code uses inline styles for the HTML elements. It's recommended to use an external stylesheet for better maintainability and reusability.

issues.description: The code uses the 'alert' function to display messages to the user. It's recommended to use a more user-friendly approach, such as displaying the messages in the HTML itself.

issues.description: The code uses the 'navigator.clipboard.writeText' function to copy text to the clipboard. This function can be a security risk if not used properly.
